title: Hausdorff measure of Lipschitz images and multiplicity bound (Simon 2.1.8)
statement: Let X be a σ-compact metric space and Y a metric space (Borel σ-algebras), m ≥ 0 real, 𝓗^m = (ω_m/2^m)μH[m] Simon-normalized Hausdorff measure, A ⊆ X 𝓗^m-null-measurable with 𝓗^m(A) < ∞, and f : X → Y K-Lipschitz on A. Then (i) f(A) is 𝓗^m-null-measurable and 𝓗^m(f(A)) ≤ K^m 𝓗^m(A); (ii) the multiplicity N(y) = encard(A ∩ f⁻¹{y}) is 𝓗^m-a.e.-measurable on Y and ∫_Y N d𝓗^m ≤ K^m 𝓗^m(A).
